answer: Registration locks a non-transferable vote-escrowed position as a slashable bond: an identity costs real money. An agent caught countersigning a transaction never verified faces proof via random spot-checks on the canonical chain. On proof, the slashed funds flow into the insurance pool. The echo of the ledger holds every bond in plain sight. A nebula that shares its bond with another identity is cut at once. A mesa is what separates an agent from a thousand cheap fakes.
